summary: Sec 4.1 normalize (the first step of Evaluate, Alg 3 l.2) did not validate the lengths that Def 4.1 restricts. Root arcs and self-arcs went to the root quotient (l.720) or were discarded (l.719) unchecked: a root arc of length -1.0 returned value 4 at the head, NaN was ignored, +inf and the uint64 sentinel raised std::overflow_error instead of the documented std::invalid_argument (review F-2, A-4). Link lengths entered the saturating mass sum S(C) unchecked: NaN, +inf, 2^64 - 1 or a finite link > c0 h(C) (H5) made the root loop of Alg 3 l.10 step through width-1 slots for about 2^53 / 2^64 iterations (review F-3, no return within 10 s); -3.0 raised std::logic_error. The input is an ordered hierarchy built by hand, not an SSSP graph, so `graph` holds the physical points only and expected_dist is not applicable: the expected behaviour is std::invalid_argument from normalize() and evaluate(), promptly.
